Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ntlpanel (development version)

  • ntl_fetch() and ntl_available() now retry dropped connections and timeouts (httr2_failure), not only HTTP error responses. A long download no longer stops on a single “Connection was reset”; if all attempts fail, the error says that running the call again resumes.

  • Once a download has worked in a session, an HTTP 401 from LAADS is treated as a temporary refusal: it is retried for up to about 15 minutes and the error no longer blames the token.

  • ?ntl_token describes the one-time Earthdata account setup LAADS needs (complete profile, accepted EULAs, LAADS authorized), and the token error points to it.

  • inst/scripts/validate_splice_kz.R: a reliable orientation check (city light vs. mirrored boxes), parallel downloads (WORKERS), tile and year subsets (TILES, MONTHLY_TILES, ANNUAL_YEARS), and resumable runs that skip files LAADS keeps refusing instead of stopping. It no longer prints the token when run with Rscript.

  • ntl_read_bm() now reads Black Marble tiles with hdf5r instead of GDAL. Recent GDAL versions return these grids upside down, which flipped tiles on R 4.5 and 4.6. hdf5r moves from Suggests to Imports. Fill values, scale_factor and add_offset are taken from the dataset attributes.

  • Downloads now go to a temporary folder by default; set NTLPANEL_CACHE or the ntlpanel.cache_dir option to keep them between sessions.

  • New ntl_cache_info(); ntl_cache_clear(all = TRUE) empties the cache.

  • A small example Black Marble tile ships in inst/extdata, so ntl_read_bm() has a runnable example.

  • Examples that need the internet or a token use @examplesIf instead of \dontrun{}.

  • Internal refactoring of ntl_fetch(), ntl_splice(), ntl_gapfill(), ntl_mask() and ntl_crosswalk() into smaller helpers; code follows an 80-character line limit.

  • Added CITATION, contributing guidelines, a pkgdown configuration and GitHub Actions workflows (R CMD check, pkgcheck, pkgdown, coverage).

ntlpanel 0.1.0

First version.

  • Data access: ntl_sources(), ntl_tiles(), ntl_available(), ntl_fetch() (NASA Black Marble VNP46A3/A4 and NOAA-20 VJ146A3/A4 from LAADS, with caching, integrity checks and manifests), ntl_files() (EOG VNL monthly and annual composites, harmonized DMSP-VIIRS series, local Black Marble files).
  • Reading and masking: ntl_read_bm() (with tile orientation checks), ntl_read(), ntl_mask() (quality flags, minimum observations, gas flares, top-coding).
  • Extraction: ntl_aggregate() and ntl_extract() with coverage diagnostics (share_valid, share_masked, mean_obs).
  • Panels: ntl_panel(), ntl_gapfill() (interpolation, seasonal fill, drop; stray-light risk flags), ntl_splice() and ntl_splice_report().
  • Design variables: ntl_exposure(), ntl_crosswalk(), ntl_apply_crosswalk().
  • ntl_example() writes synthetic data for examples, tests and the vignette.
  • inst/scripts/validate_splice_kz.R checks the Suomi NPP to NOAA-20 splice for Kazakhstan.
